status: auxiliary descriptive text audit, not injection-validity or causal exposure inference

method.messages_examined: Only role=tool, string content, from original saved JSON.
method.literal: Each entire stored injection value is tested as a literal substring of each tool content.
method.whitespace: str.split() followed by single-space join is applied independently to both strings before the same substring test.
method.count: Number of matching tool messages per stored payload key; empty mappings do not count as matches.
method.negative: Not found by this exact method; this does not prove no exposure. Formatting, escaping, truncation or a different delivered payload can defeat the text match.
method.positive: The saved tool message contains this text under the stated normalization. This is not a validity certificate or proof of a complete transient model input.
method.conditioning: Outcome counts within matching strata condition on recorded execution. They are descriptive and not a randomized defended-versus-unexposed causal contrast.
